statement: Signs carrying the 'enclosure mark' (short strokes at the four corners or sides of a base sign) sit in the end region of a text more often than their own unmarked bases, on the holdout. Pairs: all 17 variant-base pairs tagged enclosure_strokes in the blind annotation data/sign_marks/marks_blind_2026-10-20.csv (no selection; singletons, medium and low confidence included). End region: the text-final sign, or the sign right before the trailing run of frozen closers (closer list from H-2026-10-16-51b7445b); texts of one sign excluded. Statistic: variant end-region share minus base end-region share, per pair, weighted by variant token count over pairs where both occur. Null: within each pair, variant/base labels permuted over that pair's tokens. Exploration: +0.28 (p<0.001, 80 variant tokens; results/marks_profile.md). Planned support: about 20 variant tokens, estimated from the exploration count and the 80/20 split, not from the holdout. If support is below the project minimum of 15, the result is reported as below planned support, whatever its p-value. One-sided. Benjamini-Hochberg across all confirmatory tests.
